items.title: A setup guide on first launch
items.text: A short welcome, a plain summary of your privacy, and the Terms and Privacy Policy.

items.title: Smoother opening
items.text: Glyde now fades in gently when it starts.

items.title: Lighter on weak laptops
items.text: Fewer background processes and a smaller memory footprint.

items.title: Update checks
items.text: Glyde can tell you when a newer version is ready to download. You can switch this off.

items.title: Glyde everywhere
items.text: Glyde now uses its own name throughout the browser.
